svg.title: Validating an exported spec against allowed variants
svg.desc: A model's exported concrete schema on the left is checked against two allowed symbolic variants in the middle; the first matches and returns a SpecMatch on the right binding H, W and N to concrete constants.

svg.text: Matching compares dimension domains, never runtime values. That is why relating two actual sizes

text.font-family: Lexend, Aeonik, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: at execution time needs a separate runtime constraint.
